name: FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt Fügen
kurzbeschreibung: FeuerWerk in Fügen, Zillertal: Europe's most modern biomass combined heat and power plant by the Binderholz Group, featuring a Wood Discovery World, sculpture garden, and rooftop terrace.
beschreibung:
Overview

The architecturally fascinating FeuerWerk Wood Discovery World is located in the front Zillertal valley in the market town of Fügen (Schwaz district) at an altitude of around 545 meters above sea level. Built on the premises of the globally operating Binderholz Group, this monumental industrial and cultural monument combines one of Europe's most modern and economical biomass combined heat and power plants with a forward-looking educational and cultural center. The building, which has received multiple prestigious architecture and timber construction awards, impressively demonstrates how sustainable forestry, state-of-the-art sawmill technology, eco-power generation, and contemporary art harmoniously merge.

Route & Requirements

FeuerWerk was constructed using state-of-the-art cross-laminated timber and solid wood elements, showcasing the architectural possibilities of the renewable raw material wood. On a fascinating, multimedia-guided discovery tour with an audio guide, visitors look through huge panoramic windows directly into the heart of energy production: they experience the delivery of sawmill by-products such as bark and wood chips, the drying process, the highly efficient combustion in gigantic biomass boilers, and the generation of green eco-electricity and district heating for the entire region. Clear display boards and interactive stations explain the global carbon cycle and the contribution of wood as a building material to active climate protection. A cultural highlight on the top floor is the SichtBAR cultural space: here, changing art exhibitions, concerts, and readings by international artists take place throughout the year.

Visit & Arrival

The FeuerWerk Wood Discovery World and the SichtBAR restaurant are open year-round from Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 16:00 (closed on Sundays). The power plant tour lasts approximately one hour (last admission for the tour at 15:00). Admission prices (as of season 2025/2026): Guided tour adults approx. €11.00, seniors approx. €9.50, children and teenagers (6 to 15 years) approx. €6.00, toddlers under 6 years free; family ticket approx. €26.00. Holders of the Zillertal Activcard receive a discount. The sculpture garden and the panoramic restaurant SichtBAR are freely accessible. Arrival by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), on the B169 about ten kilometers down the valley to the Fügen Nord exit, follow signs to the Binderholz premises (free parking at Zillertalstraße 39). By public transport: Zillertalbahn to Fügen-Hart station, from there about a five-minute walk directly to FeuerWerk.

Tips

The entire FeuerWerk building, the tour levels, and the rooftop terrace are completely barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible thanks to modern large elevators. Stop at the SichtBAR restaurant on the top floor and enjoy regional Tyrolean delicacies and homemade pastries with a view of the Zillertal. The tour is weather-independent and is an ideal bad-weather excursion destination.
